dropped: Michelin Pilot Alpin 5: real line (winter performance, 30,000-mile warranty for H/V/W speed ratings per Discount Tire Centers spec page) but no qualifying US retailer (BJ's, Tire Rack, Discount Tire Centers, SimpleTire) displayed a readable dollar price after repeated attempts; only non-qualifying aggregator prices or specs-with-no-price pages were found.

Michelin X-Ice Snow+: confirmed as a real, newly-launched Michelin line (Flex-Ice 3.0 compound, 45,000-mile warranty per michelinman.com), but it is new enough that no qualifying US retailer (Tire Rack, BJ's, Mavis, Discount Tire, SimpleTire, Walmart) had a distinct product page priced under its own name; all current listings found are for the older 'X-Ice Snow'.

Michelin Latitude Sport (plain, pre-'Latitude Sport 3'): every search for 'Michelin Latitude Sport' returned results actually for the 'Latitude Sport 3' line, or prices attributed inconsistently between the two; could not isolate a price confidently belonging to the original non-'3' line without risking conflation, so dropped rather than guessed.

Continental ExtremeContact Force: no acceptable-retailer page could be loaded or confirmed after 4+ search/fetch attempts (Tire Rack, SimpleTire, Mavis, Priority Tire, Tires Easy); it is a niche 200-UTQG track/competition tire with very limited retail distribution. Only range prices ($194-$714) from non-qualifying retailers turned up.

Pirelli Scorpion MS: no precise single-product page at a qualifying retailer with a clean, size-specific listed price; SimpleTire search results only yielded an AI-synthesized aggregate price attached to a brand-category page rather than a verifiable product URL, and other sources quoting sizes were non-qualifying retailers or range/'starting at' prices.

Pirelli Winter SnowControl Serie 3: appears discontinued/out of stock at every qualifying retailer checked (SimpleTire shows 0 sizes available; Priority Tire product URLs returned 404; Discount Tire's page had no visible price; Walmart blocked by CAPTCHA; Mavis requires client-side JS size selection WebFetch cannot execute). No non-fabricated price could be confirmed.

Pirelli P Zero Corsa System: likely discontinued/limited OE-fitment line; SimpleTire's dedicated pages ('right' and 'direzionale' variants) show 0 sizes in stock with no price, and a Walmart product page exists but only returned a bot-check page on fetch. No qualifying retailer's own product-page price could be read after 3+ attempts.
Michelin Primacy 3: dropped on review 2026-10-06; its link is a category page, so its price is tied to no product.
Michelin Primacy XC: its warranty dropped on review 2026-10-06, read from another listing than the one priced.
